# Autolisting — AI Listing Generator

**Upload a video + details, get a finished, formatted listing in a 10-step pipeline.**

Autolisting turns raw property video and a few fields into a polished, publish-ready listing. It runs a visible 10-step pipeline so the user can see exactly where the machine is and step in when needed — automation with transparency.

## Highlights
- Video upload → structured listing
- Visible multi-step processing pipeline
- Reduces a manual copywriting task to a review

## Stack
Node.js, LLM, Media processing
